notes.title: How to Fix Bugs and Issues After the April 17, 2025 Update
notes.notes:
Dear users,
If you encounter bugs or issues with loading save data after the update on April 17, 2025 (GMT+8), please follow the two troubleshooting steps below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44803707/b44ecbe1640e0fada3facb6ac7e57c16cb176953.jpg[/img]
① On the Steam Library page, click the gear icon on the right > Properties > DLC,
and check if the DLC file size is the correct version: 151.77MB.
If the file size is incorrect, please update the game to the latest version to ensure the DLC displays as 151.77MB.

② If the file size is correct or if you haven’t purchased the DLC but are still encountering bugs or issues preventing gameplay,
please go to the following location:
「C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common」
Manually delete the “YARISUTEMESUBUTA” folder, then reinstall the base game, DLC, and any additional files.
This should resolve the issue and allow you to play the game normally.

notes.title: 20250422 DLC1 Update
notes.notes:
Update details:
-Fixed several Bugs.

If you have previously installed external files and encounter any issues after updating, please try the following steps:
Go to: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common
Manually delete the folder named "YARISUTEMESUBUTA" (Uninstalling via Steam may not completely remove it), then reinstall all game contents.
